name: parquet-explorer
title_zh: 丢来个 parquet 先告诉你每列脏在哪
tagline_zh: 拿到陌生 .parquet 不用先写 pandas 试错：直接给出行数、每列空值率、唯一值数。
tagline_en: Stop guessing at unfamiliar .parquet files: row count, per-column null rate, uniques, min/max/mean, plus real.
desc_en: Profiles and explores .parquet files -- schema, row count, per-column stats (nulls, uniques, min/max/mean), and a sample of rows. Use this whenever the user mentions a .parquet file, asks what's in one, wants to inspect/preview/understand a parquet dataset, or references a path ending in .parquet -- even if they don't explicitly say "parquet" or "profile" (e.g. "what's in this data file", "can you
why_zh: 统计和样本一起给，不写代码就能看出哪列全是空、哪列基数爆炸、哪列数值范围离谱。
why_en: Stats and sample rows together: spot all-null columns, exploding cardinality, and absurd ranges without writing a line of code.
limit_zh: 只读不写：不做清洗、不做转换、不导出新 parquet；大文件按采样统计，精确唯一值数在超高基数列上可能只是估算。
limit_en: Read-only: no cleaning, no transforms, no export. Large files are sampled; exact uniques may be estimated on very high-cardinality columns.
title_en: Drop a parquet, see which columns are dirty
